name: Figurine of Wondrous Power, Ebony Fly

text.plain: A Figurine of Wondrous Power is a pocket-sized statuette that becomes its specified living creature when thrown to the ground with a Magic action. This ebony statuette, carved in the likeness of a horsefly, can become a Giant Fly for up to 12 hours and can be ridden as a mount. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 2 days have passed.
